# Nell Harcourt

- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Schoolteacher; University student (B.A. graduate from Wexcombe College)  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v3 c30 P14](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0014), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is tall, slim, and pale-complexioned with gray eyes and freckles. Her hair is distinctly red and curly, which she crops short at one point after an unfortunate dyeing incident, though it later darkens to a richer auburn shade that she styles in soft ringlets or braids. As she grows into young womanhood, she develops a slender, graceful figure, expressive features, and an airy posture.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c27 P34](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0034), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P6](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0006), [v3 c33 P0](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0000), [v3 c33 P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)_

## Personality

Nell is an intensely imaginative, romantic, and emotional individual who experiences life with passionate enthusiasm and deep empathy. Though prone to dramatic outbursts, daydreaming, and impetuous blunders, she possesses a fierce sense of honor, honesty, and gratitude toward those who show her kindness. She is intellectually gifted, highly ambitious, and determined to improve herself despite her self-conscious insecurities regarding her looks. Warm-hearted and generous, she forms profound bonds of friendship and demonstrates remarkable resilience when facing life's hardships.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P40](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0040), [v1 c15 P94](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0094), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P40](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0040), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003)_

## History

Brought to Brierley, Prince Edward Island, by mistake instead of an orphan boy requested by the Abernethys, Nell initially faces rejection but wins over Obed and Thirza Abernethy with her loquacious, imaginative spirit and is allowed to stay at Grey Shutters. She makes fast friends with Isolde Pembroke and attends Brierley School, where she engages in fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow. Despite several dramatic mishaps—including accidentally intoxicating Isolde with currant wine, losing Thirza's amethyst brooch, and chopping off her own hair after a disastrous attempt to dye it black—she endears herself to the community. When Obed dies suddenly from the shock of losing his life savings in a bank crash, Nell sacrifices her immediate chance to attend college in order to stay with Thirza and teach at Brierley School. She saves the life of young Posy Fay Pembroke during an attack of croup, cementing her reconciliation with Mrs. Pembroke. Later, after graduating from Wexcombe College with High Honors in English and winning the Avery Scholarship, Nell declines a college path to stay at Grey Shutters when Thirza's eyesight fails, taking a teaching post at Brierley School. Eventually, after a long and misunderstandings-laden courtship, she accepts the proposal of her former rival, Hugh Carrow, and marries him in the orchard at Grey Shutters before departing for their new home at Seven Gulls Harbor.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c3 P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c14 P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c18 P32](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0032), [v1 c27 P33](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0033), [v1 c36 P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c38 P23](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0023), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned in infancy after both parents, schoolteachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, died of fever within days of each other  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for four Thomas children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Taken in by Mrs. Rudge for over two years in a lonely clearing, where she looked after three consecutive sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum in Nova Scotia before being brought to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by siblings Thirza and Obed Abernethy of Grey Shutters at age eleven  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> I am not wanted by you! My not being a boy is why you don’t want me! It should have been anticipated by me. Me, nobody ever wanted. That it was all far too lovely to endure ought to have been known to me.  <sub>[v1 c3 P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008)</sub>

> Experience has taught me that if a person firmly resolves to enjoy things, they almost always can.  <sub>[v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000)</sub>

> My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.  <sub>[v1 c5 P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)</sub>

> Going back to a place I know is truly home feels wonderful. Grey Shutters has my love already, even though I have never cared for anywhere else before.  <sub>[v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)</sub>

> Anticipating events accounts for half of their enjoyment. The items themselves might elude you; yet you cannot be deprived of the delight of anticipating them.  <sub>[v1 c13 P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019)</sub>
